% 06.08.2025 CRL.M.(BAIL) 1373/2024 (suspension of sentence)
1. The present application has been filed seeking suspension of sentence during the pendency of the appeal.

2. By way of appeal, the appellant seeks to assail the judgement of conviction dated 27.03.2024 vide which he has been convicted for offences punishable under Sections 342/376/506 IPC and Section 6 of POCSO Act and order on sentence dated 24.04.2024 vide which he has been directed to undergo rigorous imprisonment for a period of 10 years for the offence punishable under Section 376 IPC alongwith payment of fine of Rs.10,000/-, in default whereof, he was directed to further undergo simple imprisonment for a period of two months.
He was further sentenced to undergo RI for a This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/08/2025 at 22:48:55 period of 6 months and fine of Rs.1,000/- and in default of payment of fine to undergo SI for one month.
He was further sentenced to undergo RI for one year with fine of Rs.1,000/- for the offence punishable under Section 506 IPC with fine of Rs.1,000/- and in default thereof SI for two months.

sentences.text: been directed to run concurrently.
3. Mr. Adit S. Pujari, learned counsel appearing for the appellant/applicant assails the impugned judgment by contending that there is delay of about two months in reporting the incident.

He further submits that the statement of victim suffers from material improvements at the time of recording of her deposition inasmuch as in the initial information given to her father, there is no mention of penetrative sexual assault.
He further refers to the nominal roll of the appellant to submit that the appellant has already undergone more than 80% of his sentence.
4. The aforesaid contentions are resisted by learned APP for State duly assisted by learned counsel for the victim.

5. The nominal roll of the appellant is on record, as per which as on 31.07.2025, the appellant has undergone sentence of about 8 years and 14 days with remission of 4 months and 16 days and the unexpired portion is only one year and 7 months.
The jail conduct of the appellant is stated to be satisfactory.

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances, the sentence of the appellant/applicant is suspended during the pendency of the appeal on his furnishing of a personal bond in the sum of Rs.10,000/- with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the concerned Trial Court/
Duty J.M./ link J.M./Jail Superintendent and also subject to the further following This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 06/08/2025 at 22:48:55 conditions:-
(i) In case of change of residential address, the appellant shall promptly inform the same to the concerned Investigating Officer as well as to this Court.
(ii) The appellant shall regularly appear before the Court as and when the appeal is taken up for hearing.
(iii) The appellant will not get in touch directly or indirectly with the victim.
7. With the above directions, the application is disposed of.
8. A copy of this order be communicated electronically forthwith to the concerned Jail Superintendent for information and necessary compliance.
9. Copy of this order be also uploaded on the website forthwith.
List this appeal in due course at its own turn.
